paragraphs: Sasson. A certain sectarian (min) in the time of R' Abahu. Sukkah 48b.[^1]

notes.text: Min (מין) means a sectarian or heretic. Hyman places this person in Abahu’s time, without a teacher–student claim. Sukkah 48b follows מח: under the colon convention, without independent edition-specific verification. Abahu’s abbreviated title remains R'.
